title: Agent 3D observable reasoning loop
summary: From claimed job to committed source: a structured goal and plan, then a bounded turn-by-turn loop where Agent3D makes one decision at a time and the orchestrator executes it, gates completion, and only then validates and commits.

nodes.label: 1 · Job Claimed
nodes.description: A Python worker replica claims one queued or lease-expired edit_jobs row and starts a lease heartbeat.

details.responsibility: Give exactly one replica ownership of this job for as long as its lease is renewed.
guarantees: Only one replica can claim a given row (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED); a crashed replica's job is reclaimable once its lease expires.

nodes.label: 2 · Goal Creation
nodes.description: The original request alone produces a strict CadGoalDefinition: required-vs-preserve criteria, constraints, and assumptions.

details.responsibility: Fix what must become true before any plan or source exists, so later steps can't drift from user intent.
guarantees: The validated goal is checkpointed to edit_jobs.history immediately, so a reclaimed worker never re-asks the model for a goal.

failureConditions.condition: The request is ambiguous and requires clarification
failureConditions.outcome: CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED — the job ends before any plan or candidate exists.

nodes.label: 3 · High-level Plan
nodes.description: PlanningAgent turns the goal into a version-1 CadPlan of sequenced steps, using only two read-only semantic-index tools.

details.responsibility: Decide what outcomes are needed, in what order, before deciding how to build them.
steps: At most 8 read-tool rounds against index_search and index_get_feature.
Steps get sequential PS-1, PS-2, ... IDs with pending status and dependencies on earlier steps only.
Collectively, the steps must address every goal criterion.
guarantees: The plan is checkpointed to edit_jobs.history before the agent loop starts.

nodes.label: 4 · Candidate Prepared
nodes.description: Accepted source is copied to an edit-scoped candidate path; the pre-edit original is backed up and hashed.

details.responsibility: Give the loop a mutation target that is never canonical source.
guarantees: Runs once, before the first agent turn; a resumed job reuses the existing candidate untouched.
Canonical source is never modified while the loop runs.

nodes.label: 5 · Select Active Step
nodes.description: The orchestrator picks the earliest step still pending or in_progress. No step left means the loop is over.

details.responsibility: Drive the plan forward one step at a time; only the orchestrator ever writes step status.
guarantees: Tool observations are scoped to the active step — cleared the moment the active step changes, so a later step never inherits an earlier step's transcript.
The goal is never mutated by anything; only step status changes.

nodes.label: 6 · Assemble Turn Context
nodes.description: Agent3D rebuilds context from scratch every turn: goal, full plan, active step, this step's observations, recent conversation, tool catalog.

details.responsibility: Give the model exactly the bounded context it needs for one decision — nothing accumulated, nothing summarized away.

inputs.name: goal + plan
inputs.description: Supplied in full every turn, never summarized.

inputs.name: active_step
inputs.description: Only the currently active step — Agent3D never reasons about the whole plan at once.

inputs.name: step_observations
inputs.description: This step's accumulated tool results only.

inputs.name: recent_conversation
inputs.description: At most 8 recent messages, chronologically ordered — a plain trailing slice, not a summary.

guarantees: Agent3D holds no state between turns; every call is a fresh, complete context.
The tool catalog is passed via the model client's native tool-calling interface, never duplicated as prompt text.

nodes.label: 7 · Model Decision
nodes.description: One Responses API call returns one decision — its function_call items, returned unchanged, not summarized or re-parsed.

details.responsibility: Choose the next tool call(s) from the supplied bounded context and 12-tool catalog.
guarantees: decide() makes exactly one model call per invocation and returns the raw response unchanged — no parallel decision type exists.
OPENAI_AGENT_MODEL falls back to OPENAI_MODEL, then gpt-5.4-mini.

nodes.label: 8 · Execute Tool Calls
nodes.description: The orchestrator runs each requested call through ToolExecutor against the candidate; results become this step's new observations.

details.responsibility: Turn a model decision into an actual candidate mutation or read, never trusting the model's own account of what happened.
guarantees: 12 tools are registered: create/edit/delete feature, create/edit/delete parameter, create CAD part, edit build_model, check_geometry, request_step_completion, plus the 2 read-only index tools.
Agent3D never executes what it decides — Agent3D only decides; the orchestrator executes.

nodes.label: 9 · Completion Gate
nodes.description: If the agent called request_step_completion, the orchestrator checks it before honoring it — otherwise the loop takes another turn.

details.responsibility: Stop an agent that searched, found nothing, and declared victory anyway from silently completing a step that built nothing.
decisionPoints: request_step_completion on a required-criterion step with zero @cad_part features in the candidate → rejected.
Otherwise → step marked completed, orchestrator advances to the next step.
No request_step_completion → another turn on the same step.

failureConditions.outcome: Fed back as an observation instead of advancing — the agent gets a concrete correction on its next turn.

failureConditions.condition: A decision requests no tool call at all
failureConditions.outcome: AGENT_NO_ACTION — fails fast rather than assuming the step finished.

failureConditions.condition: This step exceeds 10 turns, or the job exceeds 24 turns total

nodes.label: 10 · Independent Validation
nodes.description: Once every step is completed, the separate CAD Validator executes the exact final candidate and returns structured proof or diagnostics.

details.responsibility: Prove the candidate is valid independently of the planning that produced it.
guarantees: Bound to the exact edit job, candidate path, and candidate SHA-256 — planning success is never treated as validation proof.

failureConditions.outcome: VALIDATION_FAILED — the job fails outright; there is no repair loop feeding diagnostics back to Agent3D for another try.

nodes.label: 11 · Hash-guarded Commit
nodes.description: Canonical source is written only if it still equals the accepted base hash, then re-read and re-verified against the candidate hash.

details.responsibility: Promote exactly one independently proven candidate, and only that one.
guarantees: Idempotent on resume: if canonical already equals the candidate hash, commit is a no-op rather than a duplicate write.

failureConditions.condition: Canonical source no longer matches accepted_source_sha256

nodes.label: 12 · Mandatory Reindex
nodes.description: A post-commit reindex proves the just-committed source still produces a fresh semantic index.

details.responsibility: Never leave canonical source committed without an index that describes it.

failureConditions.outcome: Canonical source is rolled back to its pre-edit backup (only if still provably safe), then REINDEX_FAILED.

nodes.label: 13 · Best-effort Export
nodes.description: Export is queued only after commit and reindex both succeed — the one deliberately non-fatal step in the pipeline.

details.responsibility: Render the committed source without risking an already-valid edit over a rendering failure.

failureConditions.outcome: Added as a warning to the terminal result; the job still completes.

nodes.label: 14 · Terminal Outcome
nodes.description: The job completes with outcome "committed": changed files, source hash, index/export job IDs, goal, and plan all recorded.

details.responsibility: Publish one durable, replayable, truthful record of what happened — not a private reasoning transcript.
guarantees: Every turn of this entire loop — llm.request/response, tool.started/completed, step.started/changed/completed, agent_loop.completed/failed — is recorded in one append-only trace file per job, correlated by agent_turn and step_turn.

edges.label: lease acquired; semantic index freshness ensured
candidate ready; step queue seeded from the plan
results appended to this step's observations
no step pending or in_progress → loop ends
fresh index proved; export queued only after
best-effort; failure adds a warning, never blocks completion

boundaries.label: Agent 3D (single Python process)
boundaries.description: Everything except the model call itself and independent validation runs inside the one worker process handling this job.
